title: Data streams and enhanced measurement
path: Admin > Data collection and modification > Data streams > web stream > Enhanced measurement
steps: In the Google Merchandise Store property, open Admin (the gear icon at the bottom left).
Open Data collection and modification > Data streams. Count every stream in the list, whatever its type (web, iOS or Android).
Open the web stream. If there is more than one, open the first web stream in the list, and use the same one when you re-check.
Find Enhanced measurement and open its settings. Note which options are switched on. Viewer access shows these settings but cannot change them.

parts.question: How many data streams does the property have?
